name: Path of the Beast
summary: A barbarian whose rage transforms them with a bestial bite, claws or tail.

features.name: Form of the Beast
features.short: When you rage, grow a bite, claws or a tail as a natural weapon.
features.summary: When you enter your rage, choose a natural weapon: Bite (1d8 piercing, heal PB once per turn when below half HP), Claws (1d6 slashing, extra claw attack once per turn) or Tail (1d8 piercing, reach; reaction +1d8 AC against one attack).

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.short: Natural weapons count as magical; swim, climb or leap.
features.summary: Your natural weapons count as magical. After a rest, choose: swimming speed and water breathing, climbing speed and wall walking, or long jumps.

features.name: Infectious Fury
features.short: Your hits can force a target to attack its ally or take 2d12 psychic.
features.summary: While in your beast form, when you hit a creature with a natural weapon, it makes a WIS save or must use its reaction to attack another creature, or takes 2d12 psychic damage. Uses: Constitution modifier per long rest.

features.name: Call the Hunt
features.short: When you rage, empower allies with extra damage and gain temp HP.
features.summary: When you rage, choose up to a number of willing creatures within 30 ft. equal to your Constitution modifier. You gain 5 temp HP per creature, and each can deal an extra 1d6 damage once per turn while your rage lasts. Uses: PB per long rest.
